responsibility: Implements the x86-specific TARGET_D hooks for the D frontend. It publishes D builtin version identifiers for 32-bit versus 64-bit x86 and hard-float versus soft-float modes, answers D __traits(getTargetInfo) queries such as floatAbi and objectFormat from x86 target state, and reports whether stdcall-style Windows linkage conventions are available under the active x86 ABI.
